name: Stunning Strike (Ex) (Rogue Genius Games)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Ninja Master Tricks
body:
Prerequisites: Master tricks, Improved Unarmed Strike feat, Stunning Fist feat or stunning blow trick

Benefit(s): The ninja can deliver a stunning attack from the stunning blow trick or Stunning Fist feat with any weapon she is proficient, rather than only with unarmed attacks.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
